chillon.name: Chillon Castle
chillon.slogan: A fortress afloat on Lake Geneva, with the Alps behind.
chillon.line: Chillon! thy prison is a holy place, and thy sad floor an altar.

lausannecathedral.name: Lausanne Cathedral
lausannecathedral.slogan: Gothic towers over the old town, and a lookout still calling the hours.
lausannecathedral.line: A lookout has watched from the bell tower since 1405 and still calls the hour from 10 pm to 2 am, every night of the year.

lavauxwalk.name: Lavaux Vineyard Terraces
lavauxwalk.slogan: Stone-walled vines stacked down to the lake, one step at a time.
lavauxwalk.line: The terraces along the lake's north shore date back to the 11th century, when Benedictine and Cistercian monks worked the land.

olympicmuseum.name: Olympic Museum
olympicmuseum.slogan: Every Games under one roof, with sculptures along the lakeshore.
olympicmuseum.line: Founded in 1993, it holds the largest archive of Olympic Games memorabilia in the world.

glacier3000.name: Glacier 3000 Peak Walk
glacier3000.slogan: 107 metres of swaying bridge between two summits.
glacier3000.line: At 2,971 m, the Peak Walk by Tissot is billed as the only suspension bridge in the world linking two mountain peaks.
